episodes.title: Reality Check
episodes.summary: Frank "The Fixer" Tagliano testifies against the mob and is relocated to Norway as part of his deal. Becoming the Norwegian citizen "Giovanni Henriksen," he soon meets the chief of police and clashes with his new country's bureaucratic culture.

episodes.title: The Flamingo
episodes.summary: Frank falls for his language teacher Sigrid and opens a nightclub that's a big hit, but he draws unwanted attention from the police and a biker gang.

episodes.title: Guantanamo Blues
episodes.summary: Now a successful local businessman, Frank joins a lucrative real estate deal but his plans are thwarted by the police, who believe he is a terrorist.

episodes.title: The Midwife
episodes.summary: Sigrid learns some surprising news, Frank's deal sours when his partner's son converts to Islam, and Geir stumbles on a clue to Frank's identity.

episodes.title: My Kind of Town
episodes.summary: Frank has a fight over a baby carriage but makes a deal to exit his real estate investment; Frank's enemies get an unexpected lead on his location.

episodes.title: Pack Your Lederhosen
episodes.summary: Flush with cash, Frank buys a new penthouse and invites Sigrid to move in, while Geir's colleagues get bad news and Mafia hitmen arrive in Norway.

episodes.title: The Babysitter
episodes.summary: The police chief suspects Frank is the link between a murder and a mysterious beating; Frank beefs up security when he learns he's in jeopardy.

episodes.title: Trolls
episodes.summary: Frank's attempt to rescue Sigrid's son leads to a spectacular shoot out and a series of shocking revelations that change both his old and new lives.

episodes.title: Milwall Brick
episodes.summary: Torgeir's mishap with a moose and a Ferrari enrages a British thief; Frank is alarmed by his twins' proposed names; Jan makes a sweet business deal.

episodes.title: Out of Africa
episodes.summary: Frank gets involved in immigration by sponsoring a computer hacker's relocation to Norway and protecting a local African emigre who's a gifted chef.

episodes.title: Fiddler's Green
episodes.summary: Frank's crew has a showdown with a family of vengeful British gangsters; Sigrid takes a trip and leaves the twins with their ill-prepared father.

episodes.title: The Black Toe
episodes.summary: Frank wins a Citizen of the Year Award and competes for financing from an investors' circle; a bank robbery has an unexpected connection to Frank.

episodes.title: The Island
episodes.summary: Frank goes undercover in Oslo to find the masked thieves who stole his valuables; Torgeir and Roar's mother returns home carrying some baggage.

episodes.title: Special Education
episodes.summary: Frank turns the tables on some blackmailing thieves; Roar and Torgeir realize their mother's boyfriend isn't the stepfather they were hoping for.

episodes.title: The Freezer
episodes.summary: A farmer's debt is paid with the deed to a reindeer herd, giving Frank a business idea; Frank meets a new love interest; Jan must flee the country.

episodes.title: Ghosts
episodes.summary: A familiar face from the old days shows up in Norway, forcing Frank to return to his New York roots for two very different types of family reunions.

episodes.title: Tigergutt
episodes.summary: It's not a happy New Year for Frank, topped off by Jan Johansen's surprise and unwanted return. Meanwhile, Roar is in Rio de Janeiro to get married.

episodes.title: Strandet
episodes.summary: Frank and Torgeir head to Brazil to save Roar from his troubles with the law, and Jan has a second thoughts about his murder confession.

episodes.title: Hjemkomsten
episodes.summary: Frank and Torgeir return from Brazil to find that the Lithuanian gang has raised the stakes, while "Rio Roar" is now a national celebrity.

episodes.title: Hoppet
episodes.summary: With the 20th anniversary of the Lillehammer Winter Olympics approaching, Torgeir hopes to fulfill a dream, and Roar gets a chance to return to Rio.

episodes.title: Tommy
episodes.summary: When Frank enters the wine business, it stirs up trouble with local activist; a mob hit goes bad; Rio spells danger for Roar yest again.

episodes.title: Der gresset er grønnest
episodes.summary: Frank's new ex-mafia crew member, Tommy, may not be as great as Frank believes, and Roar's Brazilian problems follow him to Norway.

episodes.title: Begravelsen
episodes.summary: Things look good for Jan until his new girlfriend has a fateful request; Roar signs Torgeir's life away; Tommy takes his betrayal up a notch.

episodes.title: Loose Ends
episodes.summary: The new addition to Tommy's crew shocks Frank and Torgeir; Chris vows to do anything to win back Sigrid; Frank vows to hunt down Jan.
